description: START HERE for RPC. Subscribe to Taifoon RPC in one call, no key needed first (POST /v1/access/subscribe {"create_key":true}): returns your free key (tfr_free_…, shown once, only to you), the gateway URL for chain_id (default 1284 Moonbeam; Moonbeam 1284, Moonriver 1285, Moonbase Alpha 1287 and every other chain of the gateway), your allowance today (1,000 calls a day with the key, 100 without) and the x402 top-up terms for that key (accepts on every network the facilitator settles, all paying the Taifoon vault; also the transfer quote). Call it again with api_key and payment (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for those accepts): the facilitator settles it, the key is credited and the answer carries the new balance. usdc 1 to 500 (default 1; 1 USDC buys 2,000,000 reads). Without payment but with api_key: the terms again (HTTP 402). tx (+ pay_chain_id) with api_key: writes the credit of a settled payment that was not written. Then read with taifoon_rpc or POST the gateway URL with X-API-Key. Nothing is signed or sent by this tool.

chain_id.description: the chain you want to read (default 1284 Moonbeam); the answer names its gateway URL

pay_chain_id.description: the pay chain of the transfer quote; absent = Base

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for the accepts a previous call returned

tx.description: a settled subscribe payment whose credit was not written

name: taifoon_rpc_subscribe
